blocks.text: Cuyagua, Venezuela: clear water off a rocky stretch of tropical coast

blocks.text:
## Trip highlights

The first few days take you to the Aragua coast, near Henri Pittier National Park. You can combine time at the beach with trips to lagoons and waterfalls and boat outings along the coast.

The route then takes you to Canaima. You'll cross the lagoon in a curiara, see El Sapo and take a full-day trip to Angel Falls. In the dry season, the trip to the falls may take a different form and include a night in hammocks.

Next, you'll head to Lake Maracaibo for the Catatumbo lightning. Two figures are given for its frequency: 20 and 28 flashes per second.

The trip ends in the Andes and Los Llanos, where the focus is on birds, capybaras, caimans, crocodiles, monkeys, sloths and other wildlife.
